propositions: A plan edited mid-review runs all remaining LLM passes and fails only at sign time when own_material differs, wasting all post-edit computation and invalidating Pass-1 checkpoints keyed by material fingerprint.
The cancel signal must scope to own material only (excluding relation_snapshot and ticket_store_revision) to avoid reintroducing false mid-run cancels on unrelated ticket writes.

The cancel probe must run at exactly two between-pass seams (after finders, after decide) before coach/verify recovery paths in produce_plan_review_verdict, and must never fetch or take the sync lock.
A successful cancel returns an unsigned INDETERMINATE verdict with plan-review-cancelled-stale finding and skips all downstream signing and sidecar emission, exiting with code 2.
Mid-run writes to unrelated tickets and related-material drift alone must not trigger cancellation; only own-material changes trigger the cancel path.
